description: FY 2022 23 is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. The Division of Transportation Planning from Caltrans HQ has collected the attributes on every project and every applicant they approved for transportation planning grant funds. This data is marked in points at the locations/offices of every applicant. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are place names, buildings, sustainable transportation planning grants, grant applicants, transportation planning, California, Caltrans, Districts. The bounding box given is -124.1561,32.6388,-115.0706,40.7836. The hub shows 2026-08-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the hub listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
